info.title: Smart Home - Hubs, Rooms, Devices & Concurrent PATCH API
info.description: Deterministic RESTful API for smart home topology, room assignments, and optimistic concurrency via strong ETags.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /health as a public endpoint returning deterministic persistence health.
The system shall expose GET /hubs as an authenticated user-or-admin endpoint with stable pagination.

post.description: The system shall expose POST /hubs creating a hub at revision 1 returning 201 with Location and ETag.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /hubs/{hub_id} returning the hub with current revision ETag.

patch.summary: Update hub details with optimistic concurrency
patch.description: The system shall expose PATCH /hubs/{hub_id} updating supplied fields and incrementing revision.

delete.description: The system shall expose DELETE /hubs/{hub_id} deleting only a hub with no rooms and no devices.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /rooms with optional parent hub and floor filtering.

post.description: The system shall expose POST /rooms creating a room in a hub returning 201 with Location and ETag.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /rooms/{room_id} returning the room with current revision ETag.

patch.summary: Update room details with optimistic concurrency
patch.description: The system shall expose PATCH /rooms/{room_id} updating supplied fields and incrementing revision.

delete.description: The system shall expose DELETE /rooms/{room_id} deleting only an empty room with no devices.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /devices accepting optional filters and stable pagination.

post.description: The system shall expose POST /devices validating capacity and uniqueness, returning 201 with Location and ETag.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /devices/{device_id} returning device details with current revision ETag.

patch.summary: Update device details with optimistic concurrency
patch.description: The system shall expose PATCH /devices/{device_id} updating supplied fields and incrementing revision.

delete.description: The system shall expose DELETE /devices/{device_id} removing only that device without cascade.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /hubs/{hub_id}/topology returning the hub, rooms, and devices in acyclic order.
